summary: Strategy Inc filed an 8-K disclosing routine weekly updates on its at-the-market equity offering program, share repurchase activity, and bitcoin acquisitions. Through July 12, 2026, the company sold 4,818,781 shares of Class A common stock for net proceeds of $466.7 million, with additional capacity remaining across several preferred stock series. No repurchases were made. No bitcoin purchases occurred during the period. This is a standard periodic disclosure of capital markets activity and treasury operations, not a transformative corporate event. No material terms, recommendations, or structural changes are present.
